title: Mounted archive search
summary: Recover the ordered mounted-archive search at 0x560230, including its output index and repeated range length calculation.
test_description: Compare original and recovered search with accepted index and component lookups over empty, single and two-mount fixtures, first and later hits, nested paths, missing and case-sensitive names. Check result pointers, output index, preserved fields and FS head.
known_limits: ArchiveIndex::lookup is an external dependency; the test binds it to the accepted original index lookup.
Valid mount ranges and valid null-terminated index paths are assumed; malformed ranges and overlong paths are outside the tested contract.
Concurrent mutation and exceptional paths are not exercised.
